# ripemd160

[![NPM Package](https://example.invalid/npm/v/ripemd160.svg?style=flat-square)](https://example.invalid/package/ripemd160)
[![Build Status](https://example.invalid/travis/crypto-browserify/ripemd160.svg?branch=master&style=flat-square)](https://example.invalid/crypto-browserify/ripemd160)
[![Dependency status](https://example.invalid/david/crypto-browserify/ripemd160.svg?style=flat-square)](https://example.invalid/crypto-browserify/ripemd160#info=dependencies)

[![js-standard-style](https://example.invalid/feross/standard/master/badge.svg)](https://example.invalid/feross/standard)

Node style `ripemd160` on pure JavaScript.

## Example

```js
var RIPEMD160 = require('ripemd160')

console.log(new RIPEMD160().update('42').digest('hex'))
// => 0df020ba32aa9b8b904471ff582ce6b579bf8bc8

var ripemd160stream = new RIPEMD160()
ripemd160stream.end('42')
console.log(ripemd160stream.read().toString('hex'))
// => 0df020ba32aa9b8b904471ff582ce6b579bf8bc8
```
